reason: 该插件的用户面向功能是在 DSH Web GUI 提供一键操作：点击界面按钮后调用后台 API 停止当前 DSH 进程，以便用户手动重启服务，因此可归类为自动化类实用插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web GUI 新增右下角一键按钮，点击确认后可触发接口停止当前 DSH 服务器进程，并提示用户进行重启。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a one-click button to the DSH Web GUI that triggers a local endpoint to stop the running DSH server process and prompts the user to restart it.

capabilities: Registers a local web API endpoint to terminate the DSH server process
Injects a web UI button to trigger process termination
Guides users to manually restart after termination

reasons.code: README describes a POST /api/kill-dsh endpoint and server behavior that calls process.exit(0) after acknowledgement.
package.json declares a DSH bundle patch and web client injection, indicating server+UI plugin integration in DSH.
Tree contains lib/index.js and lib/client.js implementing the kill route and the browser button logic.
